title: RepoEviAgent: Scalable Synthesis of Evidence-Grounded Repository-Level Question Answering Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.31873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world software engineering (SWE) tasks require agents to understand repository structures, cross-module dependencies, and runtime behaviors, posing significant challenges for constructing high-quality training and evaluation data. To address this, we propose RepoEviAgent, a scalable SWE data construction framework that integrates quality-aware data curation and role-specialized multi-agent task synthesis. Starting from 8,477 open-source repositories and approximately 2.48 million pull request records, we employ semantic alignment, complexity constraints, and multidimensional quality assessment to identify valuable SWE data. We further develop a sandbox-based multi-agent framework that integrates automated environment construction, execution validation, repository exploration, and evidence-grounded Q&A synthesis. translated_title: RepoEviAgent：可扩展的证据支撑型仓库级问答任务合成
translated_abstract: 真实世界的软件工程（SWE）任务要求智能体理解仓库结构、跨模块依赖关系和运行时行为，这给构建高质量的训练和评估数据带来了重大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RepoEviAgent，一个可扩展的SWE数据构建框架，它集成了质量感知的数据筛选和角色专门化的多智能体任务合成。从8,477个开源仓库和约248万条拉取请求记录出发，我们采用语义对齐、复杂度约束和多维质量评估来识别有价值的SWE数据。我们进一步开发了基于沙盒的多智能体框架，集成了自动化环境构建、执行验证、仓库探索和证据支撑的问答合成。基于该框架，我们构建了RepoEviQA，一个仓库级证据支撑问答基准，……
tldr: 该论文提出RepoEviAgent框架，通过质量感知的数据筛选与角色专门化的多智能体协作，从海量开源仓库中可扩展地自动构建证据支撑的仓库级问答任务，并建立了RepoEviQA基准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RepoEviAgent, a scalable SWE data construction framework that integrates quality-aware data curation and role-specialized multi-agent synthesis to automatically build evidence-grounded repository-level QA tasks from massive open-source repositories, along with the RepoEviQA benchmark.
